change: Standalone AST scan of the predicate in controls-url-state.md section 9: JSX use of select, combobox, segmented, number-field, slider, switch, checkbox or radio-group with no lexical ancestor in the file among the homes. 2.x-to-v3 map (home-map.json): Select, MultiSelect, SegmentedControl, NumberInput, Slider, RangeSlider, Switch, Checkbox, Radio.Group to the primitive names; ancestors FilterSet, SelectFilter, MultiSelectFilter, RangeFilter, NumberFilter to FilterSet; ViewTabs; FormRow, FormGroup, FormSection, SettingsRow to FormField; `filterSlot` custom render; a component taking a field or store handle prop to the handle-bound composite. No 2.x name maps to `ControlHome`. Each residue site is `fits a home` iff its value already lives in a handle or form field, else `waiver` (its value is `useState` or plain props). Fixtures: body children, `filterSlot.custom` with `useState`, a handle-bound composite as `.fixture.txt` through the scan; the fourth (a global spec in a card slot) is a type error: compile it with tsc against ctl-5's types.
